subject: Sierra Health: Expansion to additional apps + renewal amendment request
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@sierrahealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@sierrahealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@sierrahealth.com>

Subject: Expansion request — adding 8 new apps and renewal amendment

Hi Karthik,

Quick one — we're looking to expand our footprint with Redwood. Over the last 6 months our pilot has been stable and we're ready to onboard 8 additional internal apps (analytics, patient-intake, triage-bot, billing-audit, notifications, search-index, intake-forms, and QA tools). High level asks:

- New API keys scoped per app (we prefer one key per app/team).
- Increase reserved capacity from 2.0 to 3.5 nodes (estimate based on attached current_usage_report.csv).
- Align renewal window so expanded capacity is under the same 12-month term with the July 15 renewal date; include pricing for pro-rated increase through renewal and then the new annual rate.

Can you send a proposed amendment + SOW and an onboarding rollout plan? Procurement is cc'ed — they'd like an initial ballpark by Thursday so they can prepare the PO routing.

Attachments: current_usage_report.csv (summary export)

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Director of Technical Operations
Sierra Health

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: Expansion request — adding 8 new apps and renewal amendment

Team — forwarding Sierra's request. TL;DR: they want 8 app-specific keys, bump reserved capacity to 3.5 nodes, and a renewal alignment so the increased capacity rolls into their July 15 renewal. Procurement needs a ballpark by Thursday.

Please break down:
- Pricing: one-time pro-rated charge through renewal + new annual committed price (include both committed reserved node pricing and a burst/overage rate).
- SOW: milestone-based onboarding plan for the 8 apps (staggered rollout, expected 2-week per-app enablement, dev->staging->prod checkpoints).
- Keys: recommended key naming/permissions pattern and rotation guidance; indicate which team will own key creation vs. automated provisioning.

Ben — can you draft the pricing + capacity options?
Laura — can you own SOW and runbook drafts?
Marissa — please coordinate customer success onboarding resources and estimate required CS bandwidth (SOW should call out up to X days of enablement).

I'll own the renewal amendment language and procurement thread. Aim to have a draft back to Elena by 2028-06-23 EOD.

-Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-22T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Expansion request — pricing + capacity options

Karthik / team — draft pricing and ops notes below. Attaching a working SOW (Sierra_SOW_v3.pdf) and the customer technical contact list.

Pricing options (all amounts USD):
1) Reserved commit (recommended):
   - Increase reserved capacity from 2.0 -> 3.5 nodes (1.5 node uplift).
   - Pro-rated charge from 2028-06-16 -> 2028-07-15 (29 days) = (monthly node-rate * 1.5 * 29/30) => ballpark $6,750 (exact calc in SOW).
   - New annual committed rate (post-renewal): $230,000/year for 3.5-node commit (negotiable).
2) Hybrid (lower commit + burst):
   - Commit to 2.5 nodes, allow burst to 4 nodes at an overage rate of $X/token or $Y/hr.
   - Lower immediate OPEX, but higher marginal cost if usage spikes.
3) Short-term burst only (not recommended for production apps).

Rollout schedule (staggered):
- Week 1: Provision keys and test harness for 2 pilot apps (analytics + notifications).
- Week 2–5: Stagger onboarding 2 apps per week (triage-bot, billing-audit, search-index, intake-forms).
- Week 6: Final QA + prod cutovers for remaining apps.

Key provisioning notes:
- Recommend 1 key per app with tags: sierra-prod-<app>, sierra-staging-<app>.
- Use short TTL + automated rotation via their secrets manager.
- We'll provide a small provisioning script and a template for ACLs.

Next steps: Laura to finalize SOW; Kar thik to send amendment and offer a 10% renewal credit if they sign the amendment before 2028-07-01.

Attachments: Sierra_SOW_v3.pdf, Technical_Contact_List.csv

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@sierrahealth.com>

Cc: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@sierrahealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@sierrahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Expansion request — adding 8 new apps and renewal amendment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Procurement has reviewed the ballpark in Sierra_SOW_v3.pdf and the pricing options Ben shared. We can proceed with the reserved commit option (3.5 nodes) subject to:

- Final SOW and amendment with pro-rated charge broken out clearly.
- Standard security/compliance addendum (send SOC2 report and data residency note).
- DocuSign for the amendment — please send a link; we'll route internally for PO and signature.

Procurement would also like a simple matrix showing which teams/apps get keys and who the technical owner is for each key (the Technical_Contact_List.csv you attached looks close; please expand to include primary/secondary engineers).

If you can send the DocuSign and the finalized SOW today or tomorrow we can start internal approval and aim to return a signed amendment by 2028-07-02.

Regards,
Procurement Team
